context: Two teens plan a summer festival outing
purpose: Teach: フェイス/ストレート/クイズ/ミステリー/散策/Tシャツ/年賀状/七夕

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 七夕祭り、新しいTシャツ着てこ。
lines.en: Let's wear new T-shirts to the Tanabata festival.
lines.style: Bright, forward-leaning enthusiasm. Quick tempo on the opening. The energy of someone already picturing it. Slight upswing at the end—inviting him in.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: いいね。屋台のクイズイベント、絶対参加する。
lines.en: Yeah, sounds good. I'm definitely doing that quiz event.
lines.style: Warm agreement, a beat of genuine interest. Not performative—he's actually considering it. Steady eye contact level. Light emphasis on 「絶対」 without overselling.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 今年はミステリー要素ある肝試しもあるって。
lines.en: And apparently this year they've got a mystery-themed dare game too.
lines.style: Conspiratorial energy. Leaning in slightly with the new information. Quick tempo, building momentum. Tone says 'you won't believe this part'—testing his reaction.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: マジか。フェイスペイントもしてもらおうぜ。
lines.en: No way. Let's get face paint done while we're there.
lines.style: Genuine surprise shifting into enthusiasm. Faster beat on 「マジか」. Rides the momentum—not asking permission, proposing partnership. Slight exhale of excitement underneath.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 帰り、川辺の散策コースもいいかも。ストレートで歩けば二十分。
lines.en: The riverside walk on the way back could be nice too. It's straight, about twenty minutes.
lines.style: Practical mind kicking in—tone shifts slightly more measured. Noting logistics without dampening mood. The voice of someone balancing spontaneity with reality. Matter-of-fact on the timing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 親に年賀状の返事まだ書いてないって叱られてるから、早めに帰る。
lines.en: Though I should head home early—my parents are already on my case about not replying to New Year's cards.
lines.style: Light self-deprecation masking a small constraint. Gentle complaint, not whining. Slight resignation underneath. The beat of obligation showing through his enthusiasm, but not killing it.
